title: [Dev 3.3.0-dev-d] Cannot do "Maintenance/Import Settings" and "Wear/Load Watchface" because AAPS crashes immediatelly.
symptom: On a Samsung Galaxy S21 5G with Android 14, after updating to AAPS 3.3.0-dev-d, selecting custom watchfaces or importing settings causes AAPS to crash immediately. Later versions give an error about accessing the file system when trying to access certain folders or files.
cause: The root cause was determined to be corruption in the phone's Android file system, not an issue with AAPS itself.
fix: Performing a factory reset of the phone and restoring the installation resolved the issue. After reset, AAPS directory can be .../Internal Storage/AAPS, and import settings and custom watchfaces work normally.
evidence_quote: After more extensive testing I am sure that now it works and the root cause was some corruption in my phone Android file system.
